pages.text: Sliced from an Ascension Cake; each cake yields 3 slices.$(br)Upon consumption, grants the eater:$(br)$(li)66 seconds of Nourishment$(li)66 seconds of The Pale Messenger$(li)66 seconds of Resistance IV$(li)66 seconds of Strength X$(li)66 seconds of Luck X$(br2)A slice marked with the End (The-End Cake Slice) additionally grants 66 seconds of Resistance VI, and stops time in the entire world.
